title: Megingjord

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Megingjord is a belt that can be purchased from Haldor.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.text:
The belt grants the player superhuman strength, allowing them to carry 150.0 more weight when equipped. This is represented as an effect on the character.
It is equipped in the accessory slot, and thus allows players to wear a full set of armor in addition to the belt. The Megingjord conflicts with the Wishbone and the Wisplight, which occupies the same equipment slot.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The belt is a direct reference to Megingjörð, the belt of Thor, the Norse god of thunder. In mythos, the belt shares the same capabilities as the one in-game, granting the user superhuman strength.
• When equipped, a message will appear for the player stating "You feel stronger."

Introduction. The Megingjord is a belt that can be purchased from Haldor.

Usage. The belt grants the player superhuman strength, allowing them to carry 150.0 more weight when equipped. This is represented as an effect on the character.
It is equipped in the accessory slot, and thus allows players to wear a full set of armor in addition to the belt. The Megingjord conflicts with the Wishbone and the Wisplight, which occupies the same equipment slot.

Notes. • The belt is a direct reference to Megingjörð, the belt of Thor, the Norse god of thunder. In mythos, the belt shares the same capabilities as the one in-game, granting the user superhuman strength.
